facts.fact: UNU-EGOV says a preliminary version of the National Digital Transformation Strategy (ENTD.GW) was presented on 27 November 2024 and a validation workshop of about 70 participants was held on 29 November 2024.

UNU-EGOV says a full-day validation workshop on 29 November 2024 on the draft National Digital Transformation Strategy gathered about 70 participants from ministries, public administration institutions and the private sector.
